text: BAM share rose 0.8 percentage points over 26 hours and 0.73 percentage points over 7 days, reaching 33.6% of Solana stake routed through BAM. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 22.5% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 63 top-node leadership changes in this window fit whale-driven routing, not evidence of another structural rollover.
